cn-20261031-news-2.title: Urban and Rural Resident Medical Insurance Payment Season Begins: How to Pay, How Much to Pay, and What Happens If You Don't Pay for 2027?

segments.src: 每年第四季度,是城乡居民基本医疗保险(以下简称"居民医保")的集中缴费期。2027年度的缴费工作已陆续在各地展开。很多人对"交多少钱""错过会怎样""孩子和灵活就业者怎么办"并不清楚。本文梳理这些常见问题,供大家参考。
segments.tr: Every fourth quarter is the centralized payment period for the Basic Medical Insurance for Urban and Rural Residents (hereinafter referred to as "Resident Medical Insurance"). Payment work for the 2027 policy year has started successively in various regions. Many people are unclear about "how much to pay", "what happens if I miss it", and "what about children and flexible workers". This article compiles these common questions for your reference.

segments.src: > 提示:各地缴费标准、截止日期和等待期规定并不一致,下文数字多为全国层面的大致情况,具体请以本地医保部门的最新通知为准。
segments.tr: > Tip: Payment standards, deadlines, and waiting period regulations vary by region. Most figures below represent general national conditions; please refer to the latest notices from local medical insurance departments for specific details.

segments.src: ## 一、缴费时间:四季度集中,次年享受待遇
segments.tr: ## I. Payment Time: Concentrated in the Fourth Quarter, Benefits Enjoyed the Following Year

segments.src: 居民医保实行"年度缴费、次年享受待遇"的方式。
segments.tr: Resident medical insurance implements the approach of "paying within the year, enjoying benefits the following year".

segments.src: - **集中缴费期**:多数地区在每年9月至12月之间,个别地区会延至次年初,具体起止日期各地不同。
segments.tr: - **Centralized payment period**: In most regions, it is between September and December each year, while some regions extend it to the beginning of the following year. Specific start and end dates vary by region.

segments.src: - **待遇期**:2027年度的待遇期通常对应2027年1月1日至12月31日。在集中缴费期内完成缴费,2027年1月1日起就能享受报销。
segments.tr: - **Benefit period**: The benefit period for 2027 usually corresponds to January 1 to December 31, 2027. Complete the payment within the centralized payment period to enjoy reimbursement starting January 1, 2027.

segments.src: - **缴费渠道**:一般包括国家医保服务平台App、各省市医保公众号或小程序、支付宝和微信的城市服务入口、税务部门的电子税务局,以及乡镇(街道)、村(社区)的代收点。办理时请认准官方渠道,不要轻信陌生链接或个人转账。
segments.tr: - **Payment channels**: Generally include the National Medical Insurance Service Platform App, provincial and municipal medical insurance official WeChat accounts or mini-programs, Alipay and WeChat city service portals, the electronic taxation bureau of the taxation department, and collection points in townships (subdistricts) and villages (communities). Please look for official channels when processing and do not trust strange links or personal transfers easily.

segments.src: ## 二、交多少:个人缴费加财政补助
segments.tr: ## II. How Much to Pay: Personal Contribution Plus Financial Subsidy

segments.src: 居民医保的筹资由两部分构成:个人缴费和财政补助。
segments.tr: The financing of resident medical insurance consists of two parts: personal contributions and financial subsidies.

segments.src: 个人缴费**
segments.tr: Personal Contribution**

segments.src: 近年来,全国个人缴费标准逐步上调。以2025年度为例,全国层面的个人缴费标准为每人每年400元,各地在此基础上有所浮动。2027年度的具体金额以所在省、市公布的为准。
segments.tr: In recent years, the national personal contribution standard has been gradually adjusted upward. Taking the 2025 policy year as an example, the national-level personal contribution standard was 400 yuan per person per year, with local variations based on this baseline. The specific amount for the 2027 policy year shall be subject to the announcements by the respective provinces and cities.

segments.src: 此外,多数地区对特殊群体有减免或全额资助,常见的有:
segments.tr: In addition, most regions offer exemptions or full subsidies for special groups. Common ones include:

segments.src: - 特困人员、低保对象、返贫致贫人口等,由政府全额或部分资助参保;
segments.tr: - Destitute individuals, recipients of subsistence allowances, people lifted out of poverty and at risk of returning to poverty, etc., whose insurance is fully or partially subsidized by the government;

segments.src: - 部分地区对重度残疾人、低收入家庭的在校学生等给予一定程度的缴费补贴。
segments.tr: - Certain regions provide varying degrees of contribution subsidies for severely disabled persons, students in school from low-income families, etc.

segments.src: 财政补助**
segments.tr: Financial Subsidy**

segments.src: 财政补助是居民医保的重要资金来源。以2025年度为例,各级财政对居民医保的人均补助标准不低于每年700元。也就是说,个人实际缴纳的只是总筹资中较小的一部分,多数人缴的钱远低于自己所享受的保障水平。
segments.tr: Financial subsidies are an important source of funding for resident medical insurance. Taking the 2025 policy year as an example, the per capita subsidy standard from financial departments at all levels for resident medical insurance was no less than 700 yuan per year. In other words, the amount paid personally is only a smaller part of the total financing, and most people pay far less than the level of protection they enjoy.

segments.src: 能保障什么**
segments.tr: What is Protected**

segments.src: 居民医保主要覆盖住院医疗费用,以及门诊慢特病、门诊统筹等项目。住院报销比例与医院等级、是否转诊、是否在医保定点机构等因素有关,通常基层医疗机构的报销比例更高。起付线、支付比例和年度最高支付限额,也由各地分别规定。参保前建议先看清本地的待遇清单。
segments.tr: Resident medical insurance mainly covers inpatient medical expenses, as well as outpatient chronic and special diseases, outpatient general programs, and other items. The inpatient reimbursement ratio is related to the hospital level, whether there is a referral, and whether it is at a designated medical insurance institution, with grassroots medical institutions usually having a higher reimbursement ratio. The deductible, payment ratio, and annual maximum payment limit are also stipulated separately by various regions. It is recommended to check the local benefit list before enrollment.

segments.src: ## 三、不交会怎样:断档的几种影响
segments.tr: ## III. What Happens If You Don't Pay: Several Impacts of a Coverage Gap

segments.src: 不少人觉得"今年没生病,不交也没事",这个想法存在风险。
segments.tr: Many people think "I didn't get sick this year, so it doesn't matter if I don't pay." This mindset carries risks.

segments.src: 1. **次年没有医保待遇**:没有在集中缴费期内缴费,次年就无法享受居民医保报销。一旦住院,医疗费用要自己全额承担。
segments.tr: 1. **No medical insurance benefits next year**: Failure to pay within the centralized payment period means you cannot enjoy resident medical insurance reimbursement next year. Once hospitalized, medical expenses must be borne entirely by yourself.

segments.src: 2. **断保后可能有等待期**:近年来,多地对断缴人员重新参保设置了待遇等待期,等待期内发生的医疗费用不予报销。连续参保的人一般没有等待期,而断保后补交或次年重新参保的,往往要等一段时间才能享受待遇。具体时长各地规定不同,比如有的地区是3个月。
segments.tr: 2. **Possible waiting period after coverage lapse**: In recent years, many regions have set up benefit waiting periods for individuals who re-enroll after a lapse in payment. Medical expenses incurred during the waiting period will not be reimbursed. Individuals with continuous enrollment generally have no waiting period, while those who make up for missed payments after a lapse or re-enroll the following year often have to wait a period of time before enjoying benefits. The specific duration varies by region, such as 3 months in some areas.

segments.src: 3. **部分地区可能影响个人权益**:一些地方的断保记录会影响连续参保年限的认定,以及与之挂钩的待遇(例如部分地区对连续参保者给予缴费优惠或待遇倾斜)。
segments.tr: 3. **Potential impact on personal rights and interests in some regions**: Coverage lapse records in certain places may affect the determination of continuous enrollment years and related benefits (for example, some regions grant contribution discounts or preferential benefits to continuous enrollees).

segments.src: 4. **补缴不一定来得及**:有些地方集中缴费期结束后,仅有特定情形(如新生儿、新迁入人员、退役军人等)才能办理,普通人错过之后,只能等下一个缴费年度。
segments.tr: 4. **Catch-up payments may not always be available**: In some places, after the centralized payment period ends, only specific circumstances (such as newborns, newly relocated personnel, veterans, etc.) can process it. Ordinary people can only wait until the next payment year if they miss it.

segments.src: 所以,与其"赌一把",不如在缴费期内把这笔钱交上。
segments.tr: Therefore, rather than "taking a gamble", it is better to pay this money during the payment period.

segments.src: ## 四、灵活就业人员怎么参保
segments.tr: ## IV. How Flexible Employment Workers Can Enroll

segments.src: 灵活就业人员(如自由职业者、网约车司机、外卖骑手、个体经营者等),没有固定的用人单位,参保方式有两种选择:
segments.tr: Flexible employment workers (such as freelancers, ride-hailing drivers, food delivery riders, self-employed individuals, etc.) do not have a fixed employer and have two options for enrollment:

segments.src: - **参加职工医保**:近年来,多数地区已取消灵活就业人员参加职工医保的户籍限制,本人可以按月或按年自行缴费。缴费基数通常高于居民医保,但保障水平也更高,例如门诊报销范围更广,且缴费满规定年限后,退休可享受相应待遇。
segments.tr: - **Participate in employee medical insurance**: In recent years, most regions have canceled household registration restrictions for flexible employment workers to participate in employee medical insurance, and individuals can pay on a monthly or annual basis themselves. The contribution base is usually higher than that of resident medical insurance, but the protection level is also higher, such as a broader outpatient reimbursement scope, and upon reaching the required years of contribution, they can enjoy corresponding benefits after retirement.

segments.src: - **参加居民医保**:缴费低、门槛小,适合收入不稳定、预算有限的人。
segments.tr: - **Participate in resident medical insurance**: Low contribution and low threshold, suitable for people with unstable income and limited budgets.

segments.src: 选哪一种,要看个人的收入、年龄、健康状况和家庭情况。如果已有单位为你缴纳职工医保,则不需要再重复参加居民医保,也不能重复享受报销。
segments.tr: Which one to choose depends on personal income, age, health status, and family situation. If an employer is already paying employee medical insurance for you, there is no need to repeatedly participate in resident medical insurance, nor can you enjoy repeated reimbursement.

segments.src: ## 五、新生儿怎么参保
segments.tr: ## V. How Newborns Can Enroll

segments.src: 新生儿的参保要特别留意时间:
segments.tr: Special attention should be paid to the timing of newborn enrollment:

segments.src: - 国家有关规定明确,新生儿出生后,可以在规定时间内(多数地区为出生后90天内)办理参保缴费,**自出生之日起**享受医保待遇。
segments.tr: - Relevant national regulations specify that after a newborn is born, they can process insurance enrollment and payment within a specified time (within 90 days of birth in most regions), and enjoy medical insurance benefits **from the date of birth**.

segments.src: - 新生儿出生当年,往往可以随父母参保,并且免交或减交出生当年的费用,具体由各地决定。
segments.tr: - In the year of birth, newborns can often enroll with their parents and be exempt from or have reduced fees for the year of birth, which is determined locally.

segments.src: - 如果父母一方参加的是职工医保,新生儿可以选择随父母参加职工医保或单独参加居民医保,各地规则有差异。
segments.tr: - If one parent participates in employee medical insurance, the newborn can choose to participate in employee medical insurance with the parents or participate in resident medical insurance separately, with differing local rules.

segments.src: 建议在孩子出生后,尽快通过国家医保服务平台、"出生一件事"等线上渠道,或到当地医保经办机构办理,以免错过时间窗口。
segments.tr: It is recommended to process through online channels such as the National Medical Insurance Service Platform, the "Birth One Thing" service, or at local medical insurance agencies as soon as possible after the child is born, to avoid missing the time window.

segments.src: ## 六、居民医保与商业医疗险如何搭配
segments.tr: ## VI. How to Match Resident Medical Insurance with Commercial Medical Insurance

segments.src: 居民医保是基础保障,"保基本"是它的定位。它主要覆盖符合医保目录的费用,目录以外的自费药、进口耗材等,基本不能报销。因此,有条件的家庭可以考虑商业医疗险作为补充,但这不是必选项。
segments.tr: Resident medical insurance is the basic protection, and "ensuring the basics" is its positioning. It mainly covers expenses that meet the medical insurance catalog. Self-funded drugs, imported consumables, etc., outside the catalog can basically not be reimbursed. Therefore, families with means can consider commercial medical insurance as a supplement, but this is not mandatory.

segments.src: **搭配思路**
segments.tr: **Matching Approach**

segments.src: 1. **先交好基本医保**:基本医保是基础,商业保险不能替代它。
segments.tr: 1. **Pay basic medical insurance well first**: Basic medical insurance is the foundation, and commercial insurance cannot replace it.

segments.src: 2. **再看自身需求**:常见的补充包括百万医疗险(用于大额住院费用)、惠民保(各地推出的普惠型补充产品,保费低、门槛低)等。
segments.tr: 2. **Look at your own needs**: Common supplements include million-yuan medical insurance (for large inpatient expenses), Huiminbao (inclusive supplementary products launched in various places, with low premiums and low thresholds), etc.

segments.src: 3. **看清条款再买**:免赔额、报销范围、既往症与健康告知、续保条件等,都要看清楚。有些产品对已有疾病不予赔付。
segments.tr: 3. **Understand the terms before buying**: Deductibles, reimbursement scopes, pre-existing conditions and health disclosures, renewal conditions, etc., must be clearly understood. Some products do not compensate for existing diseases.

segments.src: 4. **量力而行**:保费不宜占家庭收入太高的比例,保障要与家庭经济状况相匹配。
segments.tr: 4. **Act according to your ability**: Premiums should not account for too high a proportion of family income, and protection should match the family's economic status.

segments.src: ## 七、小贴士:缴费前后要注意什么
segments.tr: ## VII. Tips: What to Pay Attention to Before and After Payment

segments.src: - **提前确认**:先在本地医保公众号或国家医保服务平台上查询自己的参保状态,避免重复缴费或遗漏。
segments.tr: - **Confirm in advance**: Check your insurance status on the local medical insurance WeChat account or the National Medical Insurance Service Platform first to avoid duplicate payments or omissions.

segments.src: - **保留凭证**:缴费成功后保存缴费记录或电子凭证,以便日后核对。
segments.tr: - **Keep vouchers**: Save payment records or electronic vouchers after successful payment for future reference.

segments.src: - **关注家人**:家里的老人、孩子、在外地的亲属,也需要确认是否已完成缴费。
segments.tr: - **Pay attention to family members**: Elderly people, children, and relatives away from home also need to be confirmed whether payment has been completed.

segments.src: - **异地就医**:在外地长期居住或务工的人,应了解本地的异地就医备案规则,以便顺利报销。
segments.tr: - **Cross-region medical treatment**: People who live or work in other places for a long time should understand local cross-region medical treatment filing rules for smooth reimbursement.

segments.src: - **谨防诈骗**:医保部门不会通过电话或短信要求你转账到个人账户,收到可疑链接请通过官方渠道核实。
segments.tr: - **Beware of fraud**: Medical insurance departments will not ask you to transfer money to a personal account via phone or text message. If you receive suspicious links, please verify them through official channels.

segments.src: ## 结语
segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.src: 居民医保是一份"小投入、大保障"的制度安排。每年第四季度的集中缴费,是一年一次的窗口期。了解缴费标准、认清断保的影响、安排好家人的参保,再根据实际情况选择是否搭配商业保险,才能让这份保障真正发挥作用。如有疑问,请向当地医保经办机构或官方咨询热线(12393)咨询。
segments.tr: Resident medical insurance is an institutional arrangement of "small investment, large protection". The centralized payment in the fourth quarter of each year is a once-a-year window period. Understanding payment standards, recognizing the impact of a coverage lapse, arranging family members' enrollment, and then choosing whether to match commercial insurance based on actual conditions can truly make this protection play a role. If you have any questions, please consult the local medical insurance handling agency or the official consultation hotline (12393).

segments.src: *本文仅为政策信息梳理,不构成保险或医疗建议,具体政策以当地官方发布为准。*
segments.tr: *This article is only a compilation of policy information and does not constitute insurance or medical advice. Specific policies shall be subject to local official releases.*

cn-20261031-news-3.title: Real Estate Developers' Q1-Q3 Report Card: Sales, Financing, and 'Ensuring Home Delivery' — How Far Is the Industry from Hitting Bottom?

segments.src: 随着三季度财报与经营数据陆续披露,头部房企的“成绩单”成为观察房地产行业走向的重要窗口。本文从销售、融资、债务重组和保交房四个维度梳理行业现状,并为购房者整理几个值得关注的风险信号。
segments.tr: With the disclosure of Q3 financial reports and operational data, the "report cards" of leading real estate developers have become an important window for observing the direction of the real estate industry. This article examines the current state of the industry from four dimensions: sales, financing, debt restructuring, and ensuring home delivery, and compiles several risk signals worth noting for homebuyers.

segments.src: > 说明:本文为一般性信息梳理,不构成投资或购房建议。具体数据请以企业公告、统计部门及官方发布为准。
segments.tr: > Note: This article is a general information summary and does not constitute investment or homebuying advice. For specific data, please refer to corporate announcements, statistical departments, and official releases.

segments.src: ## 一、销售:降幅收窄,但回升基础仍不牢
segments.tr: ## I. Sales: Decline Narrows, but Foundation for Recovery Remains Weak

segments.src: 从各大房企披露的经营数据来看,前三季度的整体特征可以概括为“同比仍承压、环比有波动”:
segments.tr: Judging from the operational data disclosed by major real estate developers, the overall characteristics of the first three quarters can be summarized as "still under pressure year-on-year, with fluctuations month-on-month":

segments.src: - **头部企业分化明显**:国有及央企背景的房企,销售表现总体好于民营房企,市场份额进一步向资金实力较强的企业集中。
segments.tr: - **Clear Differentiation Among Leading Enterprises**: The sales performance of state-owned and central government-backed developers is generally better than that of private developers, with market share further concentrating toward companies with stronger financial strength.

segments.src: - **核心城市相对稳健**:一线和部分强二线城市的成交活跃度高于三四线城市,“好地段、好产品”更受青睐。
segments.tr: - **Core Cities Remain Relatively Stable**: Transaction activity in first-tier and some strong second-tier cities is higher than in third- and fourth-tier cities, with "good locations and good products" being more favored.

segments.src: - **政策效应有阶段性**:限购放松、利率下调、首付比例调整等措施,对短期成交有一定拉动,但持续性仍取决于居民收入预期和就业状况。
segments.tr: - **Policy Effects Are Phased**: Measures such as relaxing purchase restrictions, lowering interest rates, and adjusting down payment ratios have provided some boost to short-term transactions, but sustainability still depends on residents' income expectations and employment status.

segments.src: 需要注意的是,销售“降幅收窄”不等于“已经回升”。在较低的基数上,同比数据容易出现改善,判断趋势还应结合新房与二手房成交、库存去化周期以及房价走势综合来看。
segments.tr: It should be noted that a "narrowing decline" in sales does not mean a "recovery." On a low base, year-on-year data can easily show improvement; judging the trend should also comprehensively consider new home and secondary home transactions, inventory clearance cycles, and housing price trends.

segments.src: ## 二、融资:渠道有所疏通,但分化加剧
segments.tr: ## II. Financing: Channels Have Been Unblocked, but Differentiation Is Intensifying

segments.src: 房企的资金来源主要包括销售回款、银行贷款、债券发行和股权融资。近一年来,融资环境呈现以下特点:
segments.tr: The funding sources for real estate developers mainly include sales proceeds, bank loans, bond issuance, and equity financing. Over the past year, the financing environment has shown the following characteristics:

segments.src: 1. **“白名单”机制推动项目融资**:监管部门鼓励金融机构对合规的在建项目提供融资支持,有助于缓解项目层面的资金压力。
segments.tr: 1. **"White List" Mechanism Promotes Project Financing**: Regulatory authorities encourage financial institutions to provide financing support for compliant projects under construction, which helps alleviate funding pressure at the project level.

segments.src: 2. **信用债融资向优质主体集中**:国企、央企发债相对顺畅,资质较弱的民营房企仍面临融资成本高、渠道窄的问题。
segments.tr: 2. **Credit Bond Financing Concentrates on High-Quality Entities**: State-owned and central government-backed enterprises find it relatively smooth to issue bonds, while weaker private developers still face problems such as high financing costs and narrow channels.

segments.src: 3. **销售回款仍是关键**:对多数房企而言,真正决定现金流的仍是销售回款。回款改善不明显,融资端的修复就难以持续。
segments.tr: 3. **Sales Proceeds Remain Key**: For most developers, what truly determines cash flow is still sales proceeds. If there is no significant improvement in proceeds, the repair of the financing side will be difficult to sustain.

segments.src: ## 三、债务重组:推进中,但周期较长
segments.tr: ## III. Debt Restructuring: Progressing, but with a Long Cycle

segments.src: 多家出现流动性压力的房企,正在通过境内外债务展期、债转股、资产处置等方式推进债务重组。观察这一进程,可以关注:
segments.tr: Many real estate developers facing liquidity pressure are advancing debt restructuring through domestic and foreign debt extensions, debt-for-equity swaps, and asset disposals. In observing this process, one can pay attention to:

segments.src: - **重组方案的可执行性**:是否有清晰的现金流来源和资产处置安排,而不只是延长期限。
segments.tr: - **Feasibility of Restructuring Plans**: Whether there are clear sources of cash flow and asset disposal arrangements, rather than just extending deadlines.

segments.src: - **债权人结构的复杂程度**:境内外债务、金融债务与经营性债务交织,会增加协商难度。
segments.tr: - **Complexity of Creditor Structure**: The intertwining of domestic and foreign debt, financial debt, and operating debt will increase the difficulty of negotiation.

segments.src: - **资产处置的市场环境**:在市场整体偏弱的情况下,资产变现的折价幅度和速度都存在不确定性。
segments.tr: - **Market Environment for Asset Disposal**: In a generally weak market, there is uncertainty regarding the discount rate and speed of asset liquidation.

segments.src: 总体而言,债务风险正在“逐步出清”的过程中,但完成这一过程需要时间,不同企业之间的进度差异很大。
segments.tr: Overall, debt risks are in the process of being "gradually cleared," but completing this process takes time, and the progress varies greatly among different companies.

segments.src: ## 四、保交房:稳定预期的底线工程
segments.tr: ## IV. Ensuring Home Delivery: The Bottom-Line Project for Stabilizing Expectations

segments.src: “保交房”是近年来稳定市场预期的重要抓手。各地通过专项借款、封闭监管资金、项目并购与交付协调等方式,推动停工项目复工和交付。
segments.tr: "Ensuring home delivery" has been an important lever for stabilizing market expectations in recent years. Localities are promoting the resumption of work and delivery of stalled projects through special loans, closed-loop supervision of funds, and project mergers and delivery coordination.

segments.src: 从进展看:
segments.tr: In terms of progress:

segments.src: - 多地交付数量持续增加,部分项目逾期时间得到缩短;
segments.tr: - The number of deliveries in many places continues to increase, and the overdue time for some projects has been shortened;

segments.src: - 不同城市、不同项目的进度并不均衡,个别项目仍面临资金缺口或施工协调问题;
segments.tr: - Progress is uneven across different cities and projects, and individual projects still face funding gaps or construction coordination problems;

segments.src: - 交付后的“办证”、质量验收等后续问题,也值得业主持续关注。
segments.tr: - Subsequent issues such as "obtaining property certificates" and quality acceptance after delivery are also worth continuous attention from owners.

segments.src: 保交房的成效直接关系到购房者信心。只有交付稳定、预期改善,新房销售才有可能真正转暖。
segments.tr: The effectiveness of ensuring home delivery is directly related to the confidence of homebuyers. Only when delivery is stable and expectations improve can new home sales potentially turn around.

segments.src: ## 五、行业离“触底”还有多远?
segments.tr: ## V. How Far Is the Industry from "Hitting Bottom"?

segments.src: 从目前的信号看,行业处于“政策托底、局部企稳、整体仍在调整”的阶段。可以关注几个更具参考意义的指标:
segments.tr: Judging from current signals, the industry is in a stage of "policy support, local stabilization, and overall adjustment." Several indicators with more reference value can be monitored:

segments.src: | 观察维度 | 值得关注的信号 |
segments.tr: | Observation Dimension | Signals Worth Noting |

segments.src: | 销售 | 新房、二手房成交是否连续数月环比改善 |
segments.tr: | Sales | Whether new and secondary home transactions have improved month-on-month for several consecutive months |

segments.src: | 价格 | 重点城市房价下行幅度是否收窄并趋稳 |
segments.tr: | Price | Whether the decline in housing prices in key cities has narrowed and stabilized |

segments.src: | 库存 | 去化周期是否下降 |
segments.tr: | Inventory | Whether the clearance cycle has decreased |

segments.src: | 资金 | 房企到位资金与销售回款是否好转 |
segments.tr: | Funds | Whether developers' available funds and sales proceeds have improved |

segments.src: | 投资 | 新开工和土地购置是否止跌 |
segments.tr: | Investment | Whether new construction starts and land acquisitions have stopped falling |

segments.src: 业内普遍认为,行业完成出清和模式转型仍需时间。未来更可能出现的是“总量趋稳、结构分化”的新常态,而不是短期内的快速反弹。
segments.tr: The industry generally believes that it will take time for the industry to complete clearing and model transformation. What is more likely to emerge in the future is a new normal of "total volume stabilization and structural differentiation," rather than a rapid rebound in the short term.

segments.src: ## 六、购房者该关注哪些风险信号?
segments.tr: ## VI. What Risk Signals Should Homebuyers Pay Attention To?

segments.src: 1. **开发商资金状况**:关注其公开披露的债务、销售回款及评级变化,谨慎对待资金链明显紧张的企业。
segments.tr: 1. **Developer's Financial Status**: Pay attention to their publicly disclosed debt, sales proceeds, and rating changes, and be cautious about companies with obviously tight capital chains.

segments.src: 2. **项目施工进度**:实地查看工地进度,与合同约定的交付时间对照。
segments.tr: 2. **Project Construction Progress**: Check the construction site progress in person and compare it with the delivery time agreed in the contract.

segments.src: 3. **预售资金监管**:确认购房款是否进入监管账户,了解资金使用规则。
segments.tr: 3. **Pre-sale Fund Supervision**: Confirm whether the home purchase funds have entered the supervision account and understand the rules for fund usage.

segments.src: 4. **合同条款**:仔细阅读逾期交房的违约责任、退款条件等条款。
segments.tr: 4. **Contract Terms**: Carefully read the terms regarding breach of contract for overdue delivery, refund conditions, etc.

segments.src: 5. **自身还款能力**:购房前评估收入稳定性,预留足够的应急资金,避免过度杠杆。
segments.tr: 5. **Personal Repayment Ability**: Evaluate income stability before buying a home, reserve sufficient emergency funds, and avoid excessive leverage.

segments.src: 6. **官方信息渠道**:通过住建部门、政府公开平台核实项目手续,不轻信“内部房源”“保证升值”等宣传。
segments.tr: 6. **Official Information Channels**: Verify project procedures through housing and construction departments and government public platforms, and do not easily believe in promotions such as "internal housing sources" or "guaranteed appreciation."

segments.src: ## 结语
segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.src: 前三季度的数据说明,房地产行业仍在修复的过程中:政策在发力,风险在释放,但稳定的需求和健康的现金流还需要时间来恢复。对购房者而言,与其猜测“何时触底”,不如把重点放在企业实力、项目进度和自身财务安全上,做出理性、稳妥的决定。
segments.tr: The data from the first three quarters shows that the real estate industry is still in the process of repair: policies are exerting force, risks are being released, but stable demand and healthy cash flow still need time to recover. For homebuyers, rather than guessing "when it will hit bottom," it is better to focus on corporate strength, project progress, and personal financial security to make rational and prudent decisions.
